comparison.objective: Open a folding fan by holding one guard stick and sweeping the other around its rivet; the candidate sets a gripper opening limit.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization of a light articulated object during a large arc, not concentric two-tool torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Fan reaches at least 135° and lies released on its stand, with full credit also requiring arms returned; candidate requires a locked 90° stop and cycling.
comparison.reason: Both involve an angle and counteraction, but the fan tests sweeping articulation, not adjustment retention under jam-nut reaction.
